t2.title: Parents limit their children's screen time
t2.prompt: You are participating in an online discussion forum. The topic is: "Should parents limit their children's screen time?" Write your response, giving reasons and examples. Write 180–200 words.
t2.sample:
This is such an important topic! I firmly believe dental care should be included in universal healthcare.

Firstly, oral health is directly connected to overall health. Poor dental hygiene is linked to heart disease, diabetes complications, and other serious conditions. Separating dental care makes no medical sense.

Moreover, many people avoid the dentist due to high costs. This leads to preventable problems becoming serious, requiring even more expensive emergency treatment.

Additionally, dental issues disproportionately affect lower-income communities who cannot afford private care. This creates health inequality.

Admittedly, including dental care would increase healthcare costs. However, preventive care is far cheaper than treating advanced problems.

Ultimately, teeth are part of our bodies. Healthcare systems that exclude dental care are fundamentally incomplete.

What's your experience with dental care costs?
t2.sampleA2:
Hello SmileCare,

The clinic is nice and the people are friendly. The treatment was okay, but I was a little scared.
Maybe you can have some toys for kids? And maybe the dentist can smile more!

Thank you.
t2.sampleB1:
Dear SmileCare Team,

Thank you for your email. I wanted to give you some feedback about my recent visit.

Overall, I thought the facilities were clean and modern. The staff were mostly friendly and helpful, but I felt like the dentist was a bit rushed. The treatment seemed fine, but I'm not an expert!

To encourage me to become a regular patient, perhaps you could offer some loyalty discounts or family packages? Also, clearer explanations about the treatment options would be helpful.

Sincerely,
A Satisfied Customer
t2.sampleB2: This is a topic that's close to my heart, so I couldn't scroll past without chipping in! In my view, parents absolutely should keep an eye on how long their kids spend glued to a screen. Don't get me wrong — I'm not against technology at all. Tablets and phones can be brilliant learning tools, and banning them outright would be unrealistic these days. However, too much screen time can really take its toll. Children who are constantly online often struggle to get enough sleep, and their schoolwork tends to suffer as a result. On top of that, they miss out on playing outside and spending quality time with family and friends. That said, I don't think strict bans are the answer. What works far better is setting sensible limits and leading by example — after all, kids copy what they see. Agreeing on screen-free mealtimes is a great place to start. At the end of the day, it all comes down to balance. What do you all think? Has anyone found a rule that actually sticks? I'd love to hear your experiences!
t2.uzSample:
Bu juda muhim mavzu! Men tish sog'lig'i universal sog'liqni saqlashga kiritilishi kerakligiga qat'iy ishonaman.

Birinchidan, og'iz bo'shlig'i salomatligi umumiy salomatlik bilan bevosita bog'liq. Tish gigiyenasining yomonligi yurak kasalliklari, diabet asoratlari va boshqa jiddiy kasalliklar bilan bog'liq. Tish parvarishini ajratish tibbiy jihatdan hech qanday ma'noga ega emas.

Bundan tashqari, ko'p odamlar yuqori xarajatlar tufayli stomatologga borishdan qochishadi. Bu oldini olish mumkin bo'lgan muammolarning jiddiylashishiga olib keladi, bu esa yanada qimmat favqulodda davolanishni talab qiladi.

Qo'shimcha ravishda, tish muammolari xususiy parvarishga qodir bo'lmagan kam daromadli aholiga nomutanosib ta'sir qiladi. Bu sog'liqni saqlashdagi tengsizlikni yaratadi.

Tan olish kerakki, tish parvarishini kiritish sog'liqni saqlash xarajatlarini oshiradi. Biroq, profilaktik parvarish rivojlangan muammolarni davolashdan ancha arzon.

Oxir oqibat, tishlar bizning tanamizning bir qismidir. Tish parvarishini istisno qiladigan sog'liqni saqlash tizimlari tubdan to'liq emas.

Tish parvarishi xarajatlari bilan bog'liq tajribangiz qanday?
t2.uzSampleA2:
Salom SmileCare,

Klinika yaxshi va odamlar do'stona. Davolanish yaxshi bo'ldi, lekin men biroz qo'rqdim.
Balki bolalar uchun o'yinchoqlar bo'lishi mumkin? Va balki tish shifokori ko'proq kulishi mumkin!

Rahmat.
t2.uzSampleB1:
Hurmatli SmileCare jamoasi,

Elektron pochtangiz uchun rahmat. Yaqinda tashrifim haqida ba'zi fikr-mulohazalarimni bildirmoqchi edim.

Umuman olganda, men binolarning toza va zamonaviy ekanligini o'yladim. Xodimlar asosan do'stona va yordam berishga tayyor edilar, lekin men stomatolog biroz shoshilayotgandek his qildim. Davolash yaxshi bo'lib tuyuldi, lekin men mutaxassis emasman!

Meni doimiy bemor bo'lishga undash uchun, ehtimol, siz sodiqlik chegirmalarini yoki oilaviy paketlarni taklif qilishingiz mumkin? Shuningdek, davolash usullari haqida aniqroq tushuntirishlar foydali bo'ladi.

Hurmat bilan,
Qoniqish hosil qilgan mijoz
t2.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli SmileCare jamoasi,

Sizning keyingi elektron pochtangiz uchun rahmat. Klinikangizda bo'lib o'tgan so'nggi qabulim haqida fikr-mulohazalar bildirishdan xursandman.

Muassasalar, shubhasiz, zamonaviy va yaxshi saqlangan bo'lib, ijobiy birinchi taassurot qoldirdi. Xodimlar odatda xushmuomala va professional bo'lishsa-da, biroz iliqroq yondashuv, ehtimol, shaxsiy e'tibor bilan bemor tajribasini yanada yaxshilashi mumkin. Davolashning o'zi yuqori standartga ega bo'lib tuyuldi, ammo muolajalar va keyingi parvarish bo'yicha ko'proq batafsil tushuntirishlar qadrlangan bo'lar edi.

Uzoq muddatli bemorlar bilan munosabatlarni rivojlantirish uchun takroriy tashriflar va tavsiyalarni taqdirlaydigan ko'p darajali sodiqlik dasturini ko'rib chiqishni taklif qilaman. Bundan tashqari, moslashuvchan to'lov rejalarini taklif qilish yoki sug'urta provayderlari bilan hamkorlik qilib, da'volarni qayta ishlashni soddalashtirish ham foydali bo'lishi mumkin. Nihoyat, axborot beruvchi broshyuralar yoki onlayn videolar kabi bemorlarni o'qitish resurslariga sarmoya kiritish, profilaktika yordamiga sodiqlikni namoyish etadi va bemorlarga og'iz bo'shlig'i salomatligi haqida asosli qarorlar qabul qilish imkoniyatini beradi.

Hurmat bilan,
Qadrdon bemoringiz

Men nihoyat ajoyib stomatolog topdim! SmileCare juda yaxshi – xodimlari do'stona va klinikasi juda zamonaviy. Rostini aytsam, men umuman asabiylashmadim!

t11.uzSampleA2:

Men yangi tish shifokoriga bordim. U SmileCare deb ataladi va u yaxshi. Odamlar yaxshi va tishlarim toza bo'lib qoldi. Sen ham u yerga borishing kerak, chunki u yaxshi. Ko'rishguncha!
t11.uzSampleB1:
Salom, Feruza,
Men sizga SmileCare nomli yangi tish shifokoriga borganim haqida aytmoqchi edim. Menimcha, u juda yaxshi. Xodimlar do'stona edi va klinika juda toza edi. Men u yerda o'zimni qulay his qildim. Mening fikrimcha, siz ham urinib ko'rishingiz kerak. O'ylaymanki, sizga yoqadi. Fikringizni menga bildiring!

Salom Feruza,
Yaqinda borgan SmileCare nomli stomatologiya klinikasini tavsiya qilmoqchiman. Bilaman, yaxshi stomatolog qidiryapsan va menimcha bu joy senga juda mos kelishi mumkin. U yerdagi jihozlar zamonaviy va toza, xodimlar esa juda do'stona va professional edi. Butun qabul davomida o'zimni juda qulay his qildim. Maslahatlashuvga yozilishni juda tavsiya qilaman. Agar borishga qaror qilsang, menga xabar ber!
Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan,
Feruza Yusupova

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the dental clinic. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample:
Dear SmileCare Team,

Thank you for the excellent care during my recent visit.

Firstly, the clinic facilities were impressive. The modern equipment and hygienic environment immediately put me at ease.

However, I have some suggestions. The waiting time was rather long despite my appointment. Improving scheduling efficiency would reduce patient frustration.

Additionally, the treatment costs were not clearly communicated beforehand. Providing transparent pricing would help patients make informed decisions.

Furthermore, offering payment plans for expensive procedures would make dental care more accessible.

The dentist was exceptionally gentle and explained everything clearly, which I greatly appreciated.

Kind regards,
A New Patient
t12.sampleA1:
Hi SmileCare,


I come to your clinic. It is okay. The doctor is nice. Clean. I like it. See you later.


Bye,


A Patient
t12.sampleA2:
Dear SmileCare,


Thank you for my visit. The clinic is good and clean. The doctor was nice, and I liked the treatment. But the waiting was long, and I was bored. Maybe you can have some magazines. I want to come again because it is near my house.


Thanks,


A Patient
t12.sampleB1:
Dear SmileCare Team,


Thank you for my appointment last week. I think the clinic is very modern and clean, and the staff were friendly. However, I have a few suggestions. The waiting area could be more comfortable. For example, some more comfortable chairs would be good. Also, I think it would be helpful if you explained the costs of the treatment more clearly before you start. In my opinion, this would help patients feel more confident. Overall, I had a good experience and I would consider coming back again.


Sincerely,


A Patient
t12.sampleB2: Dear SmileCare Team, I am writing to share some feedback following my recent appointment at your clinic. On the whole, I was thoroughly impressed. The facilities were spotless and up to date, and the dentist put me at ease straight away by explaining each step clearly. That said, there are one or two things you might look into. The waiting time was longer than expected, so a smoother booking system would certainly help. A quick text reminder the day before would also be a nice touch. In addition, the costs were not spelled out beforehand, and offering transparent pricing up front would allow patients to make informed decisions without any nasty surprises. Overall, I had a really positive experience and would gladly return, and I'd happily recommend you to friends. I do hope you take these suggestions on board. Yours sincerely, Dilnoza Karimova
t12.uzSample:
Hurmatli SmileCare jamoasi,

Yaqinda tashrifim davomida ko'rsatgan a'lo darajadagi xizmatingiz uchun tashakkur.

Avvalo, klinika sharoitlari hayratlanarli edi. Zamonaviy uskunalar va gigiyenik muhit meni darhol xotirjam qildi.

Biroq, mening ba'zi takliflarim bor. Belgilangan vaqtimga qaramay, kutish vaqti juda uzoq edi. Jadval samaradorligini oshirish bemorlarning noroziligini kamaytiradi.

Bundan tashqari, davolanish narxlari oldindan aniq aytilmadi. Shaffof narxlarni taqdim etish bemorlarga asosli qarorlar qabul qilishga yordam beradi.

Qolaversa, qimmat protseduralar uchun to'lov rejalarini taklif qilish stomatologik yordamni yanada ommabop qiladi.

Stomatolog juda muloyim edi va hamma narsani aniq tushuntirdi, buni men juda qadrladim.

Hurmat bilan,
Yangi bemor
t12.uzSampleA1:
Salom SmileCare,


Men sizning klinikangizga kelaman. Yaxshi. Doktor yaxshi. Toza. Menga yoqadi. Keyinroq ko'rishguncha.


Xayr,


Bemor
t12.uzSampleA2:
Hurmatli SmileCare,


Tashrifim uchun rahmat. Klinika yaxshi va toza. Doktor yoqimli edi va menga davolanish yoqdi. Ammo kutish uzoq bo'ldi va men zerikdim. Balki sizda ba'zi jurnallar bo'lishi mumkin. Men yana kelmoqchiman, chunki u uyimga yaqin.


Rahmat,


Bir bemor
t12.uzSampleB1:
Hurmatli SmileCare jamoasi,


O'tgan haftadagi qabul uchun rahmat. Menimcha, klinika juda zamonaviy va toza, xodimlar esa do'stona edi. Biroq, mening bir nechta takliflarim bor. Kutish joyi yanada qulayroq bo'lishi mumkin. Misol uchun, yanada qulay stullar yaxshi bo'lardi. Shuningdek, davolash narxlarini boshlashdan oldin aniqroq tushuntirsangiz, foydali bo'lardi deb o'ylayman. Mening fikrimcha, bu bemorlarga o'zlarini ishonchli his qilishlariga yordam beradi. Umuman olganda, men yaxshi tajribaga ega bo'ldim va yana qaytib kelishni o'ylab ko'raman.


Hurmat bilan,


Bemor
t12.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli SmileCare jamoasi,


Men sizning klinikangizdagi yaqinda bo'lib o'tgan qabulingiz haqida fikr-mulohazalarimni bildirish uchun yozyapman. Umuman olganda, men olgan yordam darajasidan mamnun bo'ldim. Muassasalar zamonaviy va yaxshi saqlangan, xodimlar doimiy ravishda xushmuomala va professional edi.


Biroq, menimcha, yaxshilanishi mumkin bo'lgan bir nechta sohalar mavjud. Birinchidan, kutish vaqti kutilganidan uzoqroq bo'ldi, bu biroz noqulay edi. Ehtimol, yanada samarali qabul qilish jadvalini tuzish tizimi bu muammoni hal qilishi mumkin.


Ikkinchidan, stomatolog davolash jarayonini batafsil tushuntirgan bo'lsa-da, xarajatlar tafsiloti oldindan to'liq aniq emas edi. Muolajadan oldin batafsil smeta taqdim etish shaffoflikni oshiradi va bemorlarga yanada asosli qarorlar qabul qilish imkonini beradi.


Ushbu kichik kamchiliklarga qaramay, men umuman olganda tajribamdan qoniqdim va kelajakdagi stomatologik ehtiyojlarim uchun SmileCare stomatologiya klinikasini ko'rib chiqaman.


Hurmat bilan,


Bemor
